mapper.select: SELECT hc.*, s.studentname, t.teachername, h.title as homeworktitle FROM homework_comment hc LEFT JOIN student s ON hc.studentid = s.studentid LEFT JOIN teacher t ON hc.teacherid = t.teacherid LEFT JOIN homework h ON hc.homeworkid = h.homeworkid WHERE hc.homeworkid = #{homeworkid} AND hc.parentid = 0 ORDER BY hc.createtime DESC

SELECT hc.*, s.studentname, t.teachername FROM homework_comment hc LEFT JOIN student s ON hc.studentid = s.studentid LEFT JOIN teacher t ON hc.teacherid = t.teacherid WHERE hc.parentid = #{parentid} ORDER BY hc.createtime ASC

SELECT hc.*, s.studentname, t.teachername, h.title as homeworktitle FROM homework_comment hc LEFT JOIN student s ON hc.studentid = s.studentid LEFT JOIN teacher t ON hc.teacherid = t.teacherid LEFT JOIN homework h ON hc.homeworkid = h.homeworkid WHERE hc.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO homework_comment (homeworkid, studentid, teacherid, parentid, content, createtime) VALUES (#{homeworkid}, #{studentid}, #{teacherid}, #{parentid}, #{content}, #{createtime})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM homework_comment WHERE homeworkid = #{homeworkid}
